Adventure Industries — Amazon A+ Content Wireframe

This wireframe maps out the seven A+ Content modules for every Adventure Industries product on Amazon, across Beaver Butter, HushVibes and Rock Candy. A+ Content is the set of wide banners below the bullet points; it opens with the brand and closes by answering the last question before purchase.

How to walk through it: pick a product under its brand and scroll top to bottom, the way a shopper would. Each card shows an example banner (a third party layout reference only), a short visual description of our version, and the copy for that module. Red lines are required safety notes; yellow lines are details we still need from you.
